EC-Directive 2004/54/EC on minimum safety requirements for road tunnels

■ All EU member states needed to implement the directive into national law. Austria: Road Tunnel Safety law (STSG)

■ applies to all tunnels >500m in trans-European road network

■ Defines organisational structure

Design Philosophy in Austria

■ Sprayed concrete

□ Can be regarded as permanent, if geochemical conditions allow  in this case no decay has to be taken into account, no load transfer to inner lining

■ Inner Shell Concrete

□ drained tunnels: usually 250 mm non-reinforced shell C25/30

□ Undrained tunnels: waterproof concrete is preferred over installation of waterproofing membrane special concrete properties and structural requirements are specified to create a concrete structure impervious to water

□ Placing of concrete lining possible, if displacements < 4mm/month
